mapper.sql: select id, space_name, space_type, rag_dataset_id, description, owner_id, space_status, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, version from kb_space
mapper.insert: insert into kb_space ( space_name, space_type, rag_dataset_id, description, owner_id, space_status, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, version ) values ( #{spaceName}, #{spaceType}, #{ragDatasetId}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, #{spaceStatus}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, #{version} )
